# Generated by tools/ai.py - the plain AI of every people
ante_default_army = {
	enable = { NOT = { tag = WLD } }
	abort_when_not_enabled = yes

	ai_strategy = { type = role_ratio id = infantry value = 75 }
	ai_strategy = { type = role_ratio id = cavalry value = 25 }
	ai_strategy = { type = force_build_armies value = 100 }
	# farms (tools/buildings.py) feed the workshops; the AI does not know them by itself
	ai_strategy = { type = build_building id = ante_farm value = 60 }
	# spend political power instead of hoarding it (the reports showed every AI sitting on ~1200)
	ai_strategy = { type = pp_spend_priority id = political_advisor value = 10 }
	ai_strategy = { type = pp_spend_priority id = decision value = 5 }
}

# Terra Incognita (WLD) is empty land, not a people: everybody ignores it, and it starts nothing
ante_ignore_the_wilds = {
	enable = { NOT = { tag = WLD } }
	abort_when_not_enabled = yes
	ai_strategy = { type = ignore id = WLD value = 1000 }
}

ante_terra_incognita = {
	enable = { tag = WLD }
	abort_when_not_enabled = yes
	ai_strategy = { type = avoid_starting_wars value = 1000 }
	ai_strategy = { type = force_build_armies value = -1000 }
}

ante_great_power_army = {
	enable = {
		OR = { tag = ROM tag = CAR tag = PRS tag = ATH tag = LAK tag = MKD tag = SEN }
	}
	abort_when_not_enabled = yes
	ai_strategy = { type = ai_wanted_divisions_factor value = 50 }
	ai_strategy = { type = building_target id = arms_factory value = 6 }
}

ante_sea_powers = {
	enable = {
		OR = { tag = CAR tag = ATH tag = SYR tag = TYR tag = SDN tag = KRN tag = MAS }
	}
	abort_when_not_enabled = yes
